title: VIX futures April 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the front contract into the 04-16 monthly expiration
source: OCC: TWO independent Cboe primary surfaces re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-04-21.md, leg 1). (1) cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (HTTP 200, 536,888 bytes) parsed into 104 symbol/expiry/price rows across 14 product roots and its two published settlement dates: the table carries a live contract row rendered `"VX/J7", " - ", "2027-04-21"` with real daily settlement prices against it (21.0267 on 2026-09-04, 21.1500 on 2026-09-03). (2) The machine-readable endpoint www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) independently returns the row `VX,VX/J7,2027-04-21,21.0267`. Arithmetic cross-check: 2027-04-21 is a Wednesday exactly 30 calendar days before 2027-05-21, May's third Friday, which NYSE's own 2027 column leaves unadjusted (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars re-fetched the same day, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes; nearest closures Good Friday 2027-03-26 and Memorial Day 2027-05-31). Two Cboe surfaces plus an arithmetic check is the standard that promoted the siblings vix-expiration-2026-09-16 and vix-expiration-2027-03-17, and `OCC:` is the prefix market-events-data.ts defines for exactly this class (theocc.com / Cboe; 3rd-Friday standard). PROMOTED from `estimate` at this event's own initial research, which is the sanctioned venue for the flip the discovering sweep correctly declined to make — that sweep's own source line said in as many words that the entry was confirm-ready here
notes: PROPOSED during the opex-2027-04-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), 5 days after that event and therefore inside the deterministic screen's own +/-5-day adjacency window. Why this one when the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 sweep explicitly declined to propose it: from that corridor it sat ~35 days out and was a mere repetition of the same event type; from the 2027-04-16 corridor it is load-bearing for a finding that ledger actually makes. VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out, so this contract's own reference is the 2027-05-21 monthly expiration, NOT the 2027-04-16 one it follows by three sessions. The consequence recorded here so a later pulse need not re-derive it: because VX/H7 already expired 2027-03-17, the front VIX future into the 2027-04-16 monthly expiration (opex-2027-04-16, estimate) is THIS contract, with only 3 trading sessions of life left — against 23 for the front contract into the 2027-03-19 quarterly witching. April's monthly expiration therefore sits nearly on top of its own vol-complex expiration where March's witching did not. Two qualifications logged rather than dropped. (1) VXM/J7 is NOT listed: the Mini-VIX rows on both fetched surfaces stop at VXM/G7 (2027-02-17), so this entry rests on the VX row alone and a Mini-VIX leg must not be asserted from it. (2) This settlement lands 6 sessions before the April 2027 FOMC decision (fomc-2027-04-28, estimate) and 2 sessions after the blackout opens (fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17, estimate), so unlike its March sibling it does NOT settle on a central-bank decision morning; the FOMC-morning-settlement structure belongs to vix-expiration-2027-03-17 and is not re-litigated here. Impact LOW: it supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 2027-04-21 opening auction, where the settlement's first prints are artifacts rather than information) and licenses nothing. No house playbook is opex- or vol-settlement-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-05 for opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|tax day, zero hits in both). AMENDED 2026-09-05 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-04-21.md); date promoted to `confirmed` by it. THE ONE STRUCTURALLY NEW FEATURE versus the March sibling, and the reason this ledger is not a pointer to it: this settlement is the MIRROR IMAGE of that one. March settled ON an FOMC decision morning and measured a decision-free 30-day window; April settles INSIDE the April blackout and measures a window — 2027-04-22 -> 2027-05-21, holiday-clean, 22 trading sessions — that CONTAINS the 2027-04-28 FOMC decision (fomc-2027-04-28, estimate; boj-decision-2027-04-28 the same day). Of the nine listed VX strips, six contain an FOMC (V6, X6, F7, G7, J7, K7) and three do not (U6, Z6, H7) — so VX/H7 and VX/J7 are an adjacent, nearly duration-controlled pair on which two mechanical stories point OPPOSITE ways. The initial research tested that and REFUSED it: the Good-Friday drag (~0.48 pts of discount on H7) and the FOMC-in-strip premium (~0.47 pts of premium on J7 at 2x FOMC-day variance) jointly demand ~0.95 points of residual separation; measured on Cboe's own curve the leftover after duration is +0.025 (2026-09-04) and -0.004, the wrong sign, a day earlier, and corr(FOMC-in-strip, residual) is +0.11 across all nine but -0.54 once VX/Z6 is dropped — not sign-stable. Generalisation both refusals now support: log(days-to-expiry) explains 97.4% of this curve's cross-section (99.5% excluding the year-end and front contracts), so THE FAR VX CURVE PRICES DURATION, NOT STRIP CONTENTS. Two corrections to this note's own earlier text, made rather than left: (a) the settlement day and the decision day are the endpoints of a 6-session span (04-21, 22, 23, 26, 27, 28), i.e. there are 5 sessions AFTER this settlement before the FOMC — the '6 sessions before' above counts endpoints, not the gap; (b) the CSV's 'missing VX/K7' that two sibling ledgers recorded as an unexplained surface discrepancy is a PARSE ARTIFACT, not a Cboe gap — this session's fetch of the same URL is 1,731 bytes, byte-identical to both siblings', and does carry VX,VX/K7,2027-05-18,21.15. Qualification (1) above stands re-verified: VXM/J7 is still not listed. Impact stays LOW and nothing here licenses a position.
